referenceImages.scope: The dairy and icehouse identified in the late nineteenth-century trading complex, interpreted as a low timber and stone service building.
referenceImages.era: The late Hudson’s Bay Company trading post in 1888.

stories.title: Fort Temiscamingue: Where the Cedars Dance at the Narrows

originalReview.notes: The exact 1876 McLaughlin image from Qualla shows the late trading post’s low gabled timber ensemble. Parks Canada identifies a dairy and icehouse, and its field report records an excavated icehouse. The reconstruction is a low timber structure with a stone base, a main storage chamber and attached service section. The exact plan and finish are estimates.

review.method: Exact Qualla archival photograph and primary archaeological records
